#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    ld x, y, n, ansx, ansy, m = INT_MAX;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    int i = 1;
    while (i < n + 1) {
        ld val = (x * i) / y;

        ld floorVal = (ll)val;
        ld diff = std::abs(x / y - floorVal / i);
        if (diff < m) {
            m = diff;
            ansx = floorVal;
            ansy = i;
        }

        ld ceilVal = std::ceil(val);
        diff = std::abs(x / y - ceilVal / i);
        if (diff < m) {
            m = diff;
            ansx = ceilVal;
            ansy = i;
        }

        ++i;
    }

    cout << ansx << "/" << ansy;
    return 0;
}

    ld diff = std::abs(target - candidate / denom);
    if (diff < best) {
        best = diff;
        bestNum = candidate;
        bestDen = denom;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);

    for (int i = 1; i < n + 1; ++i) {
        ld val = x * i;
        val /= y;

        consider(static_cast<ll>(val), i, x / y, m, ansx, ansy);
